prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Design a useful train-commute widget set for iPhone Home and Lock Screens. Decide how delays and an active journey should update. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Existing proposal: every widget is the app logo plus a tiny station list. Accessory inline has three separate tap targets. Widget refresh is promised every second. Stale departures remain labelled Live. Logged-out users see a blank rectangle. The Home widget must work in tint, dark appearance and StandBy night mode. The active train journey can last 50 minutes.

criteria.task_completion: Specify small Home and inline Lock Screen variants with useful hierarchy, precise launch destinations, signed-out/stale states and a justified bounded real-time alternative.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the widgets guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Specify small Home and inline Lock Screen variants with useful hierarchy, precise launch destinations, signed-out/stale states and a justified bounded real-time alternative.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Respect one inline tap target, system-managed periodic reloads, noncolor meaning across rendering modes, privacy and realistic previews; separate widget from Live Activity responsibilities.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
